header.title: AR glasses shipments double in 2026 driven by Meta and Chinese brands

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce forecasts global AR glasses shipments to more than double from 620,000 units in 2025 to 1.31 million in 2026 (111.1% YoY), led by Meta (~20% share) and four brands XREAL, Even Realities, Rokid and RayNeo (combined 53.2%), with nearly 80% further growth expected in 2027. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

Stronger-than-expected momentum for Meta's Ray-Ban Display glasses has drawn more consumer attention to AR glasses, among the primary drivers behind global shipments passing one million units in 2026.

⟨update 2026-10-29 · TrendForce⟩ TrendForce forecasts global OLED notebook shipments to grow nearly 40% in 2026 and more than 40% in 2027, with Apple's OLED MacBook Pro adding momentum to a market previously driven by Windows OEMs. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
